candidate_scope: typed numeric eligibility cache and borrowed cached text group IDs; exact quota, source-order additions, generic fallback for unsafe numeric comparisons and non-text keys
warmups: unchanged root worker: one initial validation and three warm calls
target_gate: each series/size/case: six positive pairs, median gain greater than median absolute baseline/control variation
control_gate: each series/size/case: median gain >= -max(2%, median absolute baseline/control variation)
adoption: all frozen local target/control gates required for a local gain claim; production-relative comparisons reported separately; full-source and peer qualification remain open
classification: new actual-path optimization against the correctness-aligned source; former experiments retained separately
correctness_baseline: production baseline fails quota and nonassociative sum parity tests; matched integer timing fixtures independently validate in both roles
result_storage: read results retained; native final six-field readback validated in full then retained by canonical digest and row count
